title: Birth and neighborhoods of New Orleans
summary: Hug gives his birth date and the wards he grew up in, and the interviewer checks where the Irish Channel was.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Can you give me some information on when you were born and where around town you were brought up?

I was born December the 6th, 1910, somewhere on Tulane Avenue. My father's memory is a little hazy now because he's very near 78. But it's somewhere around Tulane and Miro, I think. And I lived mostly around Bank Street. You might say the third ward, which took in Durgin Wall Street. And then later on I moved out in the fourth ward, which took in Lakeview. This was when I was about 12 years old.
There's someone near the channel now, don't you? There's someone near the Irish channel?
Well, at the time that I was coming up, Charlie, no, I don't believe that that was the Irish channel around that section. The Irish channel was more in the uptown section.
But you mean now, don't you live around close to the channel?
Oh, yes. That's right. Now, for the past 35 years, I've been living uptown, very close to the original Irish channel.
